episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: After stealing the Tesseract in "Avengers: Endgame," Loki lands before the Time Variance Authority.

episodes.title: The Variant
episodes.overview: Mobius puts Loki to work, but not everyone at TVA is thrilled about the God of Mischief's presence.

episodes.title: Lamentis
episodes.overview: Loki finds out The Variant's plans, but he has his own that will forever alter both their destinies.

episodes.title: The Nexus Event
episodes.overview: Frayed nerves and paranoia infiltrate the TVA as Mobius and Hunter B-15 search for Loki and Sylvie.

episodes.title: Journey into Mystery
episodes.overview: Loki tries to escape The Void, a desolate purgatory where he meets variant versions of himself.

episodes.title: For All Time. Always.
episodes.overview: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.title: Breaking Brad
episodes.overview: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone’s favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.title: Heart of the TVA
episodes.overview: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

episodes.title: Science/Fiction
episodes.overview: Loki traverses dying timelines in an attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: Loki learns the true nature of 'glorious purpose' as he rectifies the past.

episodes.title: Homer's Barbershop Quartet
episodes.overview: Homer recalls when he, Apu, Barney and Principal Skinner became recording icons.

episodes.title: Cape Feare
episodes.overview: The Simpsons go incognito to avoid the newly paroled Sideshow Bob, who's out to get Bart.

episodes.title: Homer Goes to College
episodes.overview: Homer takes Nuclear Physics 101 at the local college, where he gets a trio of nerdy tutors expelled for extracurricular activities.

episodes.title: Rosebud
episodes.overview: Burns longs for a childhood toy that winds up in the grip of Maggie.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror IV
episodes.overview: Homer sells his soul; Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner; Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

episodes.title: Marge on the Lam
episodes.overview: Marge's wild night out with neighbor Ruth includes running from the police in Ruth's car, stolen from her ex.

episodes.title: Bart's Inner Child
episodes.overview: Springfield emulates Bart after he's praised by a self-help guru.

episodes.title: Boy-Scoutz 'N the Hood
episodes.overview: After a reckless Squishee bender with Milhouse, Bart wakes to the shocking realization that he joined the Junior Campers. Lured by pocketknives and knot-tying lessons, Bart assimilates into the group but then must face the father-son rafting trip.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Homer
episodes.overview: Homer struggles with his attraction to new coworker Mindy, a beautiful engineer whose love for doughnuts is equal to his own.

episodes.title: $pringfield (Or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling)
episodes.overview: Legalized gambling comes to Springfield, and Marge becomes addicted; Robert Goulet entertains at Bart's casino for kids.

episodes.title: Homer the Vigilante
episodes.overview: Homer leads a vigilante group to catch the Springfield Cat Burglar, who then robs the museum.

episodes.title: Bart Gets Famous
episodes.overview: When an on-air remark catapults Bart to instant stardom, he finds that fame isn't all it's cracked up to be.

episodes.title: Homer and Apu
episodes.overview: Homer accompanies Apu to the Kwik-E-Mart home office--in India--after Apu is fired.

episodes.title: Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
episodes.overview: Lisa's outrage over the gender stereotypes reinforced by a new talking doll prompts her to confront the dollmaker.

episodes.title: Deep Space Homer
episodes.overview: Homer and Barney compete to be the first "average" American in space.

episodes.title: Homer Loves Flanders
episodes.overview: Flanders' extra ticket to the big game makes him Homer's new best friend, a role that sorely tests Flanders' patience.

episodes.title: Bart Gets an Elephant
episodes.overview: Bart wins an elephant, but Homer won't let him keep it.

episodes.title: Burns' Heir
episodes.overview: Bart is picked to be Burns' heir and moves into the Burns mansion, prompting Homer and Marge to hire a deprogrammer to get him back.

episodes.title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
episodes.overview: Bart takes his dog to school, which gets Skinner fired, which in turn leaves Bart missing his archnemesis.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Knew Too Much
episodes.overview: Bart can clear Mayor Quimby's nephew of a charge of battery, but only by implicating himself as a hooky player.

episodes.title: Lady Bouvier's Lover
episodes.overview: Grandpa Simpson falls for Marge's mother, but loses out to a competitor; Bart gets ripped off shopping at home with Homer's credit card.

episodes.title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
episodes.overview: Homer teaches a class on marriage, but sharing secrets about his own union gets him kicked out of the house.

episodes.title: Bart of Darkness
episodes.overview: Stuck in his room with a broken leg, Bart hears a high-pitched scream. When he looks through his telescope, he sees a guilty Ned Flanders burying the evidence.

episodes.title: Lisa's Rival
episodes.overview: Lisa feels threatened when a new girl moves to Springfield: Allison is smart, pretty, a great saxophone player and a crack diorama builder. Lisa tries to befriend her new rival, but she's consumed with envy and competitiveness.

episodes.title: Another Simpsons Clip Show
episodes.overview: After reading the weepy best-seller The Bridges of Madison County, Marge sits down with the family and recalls romantic moments, along with temptations from her bowling instructor Jacques and Homer's coworker Mindy.

episodes.title: Itchy & Scratchy Land
episodes.overview: The family's trip to Itchy & Scratchy Land takes an unexpected turn when high-tech robots malfunction and become violent.

episodes.title: Sideshow Bob Roberts
episodes.overview: Mayor Quimby pardons attempted murderer Sideshow Bob, who then runs against Quimby for mayor.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror V
episodes.overview: Lack of beer and cable TV make Homer a crazed killer; the present is altered by a time-traveling Homer; and Principal Skinner turns detention students into food.

episodes.title: Bart's Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Bart learns that the good Reverend Lovejoy's daughter is really bad.

episodes.title: Lisa on Ice
episodes.overview: Lisa's surprising ability at hockey spawns jealousy in Bart and a showdown when their teams meet.

episodes.title: Homer Badman
episodes.overview: When Homer gropes for a gummy candy stuck to the babysitter's pants, she mistakes his intentions and turns the town against him.

episodes.title: Grampa vs. Sexual Inadequacy
episodes.overview: Grandpa's homemade tonic puts life back in the Simpson bedroom, so he and Homer hit the road to sell the stuff.

episodes.title: Fear of Flying
episodes.overview: When they try to go on vacation, the family discovers Marge's debilitating fear of flying. Marge consults a psychoanalyst to find the source of her baffling fear.

episodes.title: Homer the Great
episodes.overview: Homer joins the secret society of the Stonecutters and is suddenly exalted when the brethren discover his birthmark. The ancient order is shaken to the core by the ineptitude of its new Chosen One.

episodes.title: And Maggie Makes Three
episodes.overview: The story of Maggie's birth is told in flashbacks: after Homer quits the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant to pursue his dream of working at a bowling alley, Marge reveals that she is pregnant.

episodes.title: Bart's Comet
episodes.overview: When Bart is forced to assist Principal Skinner in early-morning astronomy observations, he discovers a giant comet heading towards Springfield. Facing impending doom, the entire town shows up at the Flanders family bomb shelter.

episodes.title: Homie the Clown
episodes.overview: Krusty the Clown's reckless spending forces him to open a clown college to keep afloat. New graduate Homer discovers the perks and perils of being Krusty.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Australia
episodes.overview: After tricking an Australian boy into accepting a collect call, Bart flies Down Under to apologize.

episodes.title: Homer vs. Patty and Selma
episodes.overview: A loan from Patty and Selma makes Homer their slave; Bart is forced to take ballet.

episodes.title: A Star Is Burns
episodes.overview: Film critic Jay Sherman is among the judges at the Springfield Film Festival, which Mr. Burns conspires to win by bribing some judges.

episodes.title: Lisa's Wedding
episodes.overview: A fortuneteller predicts Lisa's engagement and wedding to a fellow student from an upper-crust British family.

episodes.title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
episodes.overview: The Simpson household's overrun with puppies--the offspring of Santa's Little Helper and his new girlfriend from which Mr. Burns would love to make a greyhound-skin tuxedo.

episodes.title: The PTA Disbands
episodes.overview: Bart helps precipitate a teachers strike, but he rues his handiwork when Marge takes over for Mrs. Krabappel.

episodes.title: Round Springfield
episodes.overview: Bart winds up in the hospital as a result of eating Krusty cereal, and when Lisa comes to visit him, she is reunited with her sax idol.

episodes.title: The Springfield Connection
episodes.overview: Marge joins the police force after thwarting a criminal, and Homer thinks he now has a free ride as a cop's spouse.

episodes.title: Lemon of Troy
episodes.overview: Springfield boys try to recapture the town's beloved lemon tree after it's stolen.

episodes.title: Who Shot Mr. Burns? (1)
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns makes many enemies when he steals the oil discovered beneath Springfield Elementary.

episodes.title: Who Shot Mr. Burns? (2)
episodes.overview: With Mr. Burns shot, Chief Wiggum investigates the crime, and nearly everyone in town has a motive. At the end, it all comes down to the Simpson DNA.

episodes.title: Radioactive Man
episodes.overview: Bart auditions for the part of Fallout Boy in the movie "Radioactive Man," being filmed in Springfield.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Homediddly-Dum-Doodily
episodes.overview: When Homer and Marge are found to be unfit parents, the kids are placed with the Flanders family. Reluctant participants in the Flanderses' wholesome family activities, Bart and Lisa become the targets of an emergency baptism.

episodes.title: Bart Sells His Soul
episodes.overview: Bart sells his soul to Milhouse for five dollars, but soon regrets his decision. Meanwhile, Moe turns the Tavern into a family-friendly restaurant.

episodes.title: Lisa the Vegetarian
episodes.overview: After visiting a local petting zoo, Lisa becomes a vegetarian and faces ridicule from family and friends. When she lashes out and ruins Homer's barbecue, she learns a lesson in tolerance.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror VI
episodes.overview: In "Attack of the 50 Foot Eyesores," strange atmospheric conditions bring giant advertising statues to life. In "Nightmare on Evergreen Terrace," Groundskeeper Willie is killed in a freak accident and seeks revenge in the childrens' dreams. In the final segment, Homer steps through a secret portal and becomes three-dimensional.

episodes.title: King-Size Homer
episodes.overview: Homer tries to gain sixty pounds so he can stay home on disability. When he nearly causes a catastrophe at the plant, Homer reconsiders his plan.

episodes.title: Mother Simpson
episodes.overview: Homer discovers that his mother is still alive, a former radical who is a fugitive from the law. When her old nemesis Burns spots her and tips off the FBI, she is forced to return to the underground.

episodes.title: Sideshow Bob's Last Gleaming
episodes.overview: After Sideshow Bob escapes from prison, the Springfield Air Show is the setting for his ill-fated vendetta against television and Krusty the Clown.

episodes.title: The Simpsons 138th Episode Spectacular
episodes.overview: Troy McClure hosts a behind-the-scenes look at the show, including clips of the series' beginnings as shorts on "The Tracy Ullman Show," Simpsons trivia questions, and unaired scenes from popular episodes.

episodes.title: Marge Be Not Proud
episodes.overview: Nabbed for shoplifting, Bart manages to keep it a secret from the family... until it's time to have the family Christmas photo taken at the Try-N-Save.

episodes.title: Team Homer
episodes.overview: Homer catches Mr. Burns in an ether-induced haze and asks for $500 for his bowling team. When Burns' head clears, he demands to join the team. Meanwhile, Bart's inflammatory T-shirt provokes Principal Skinner to require school uniforms.

episodes.title: Two Bad Neighbors
episodes.overview: Homer resents being upstaged when former president George Bush moves into the neighborhood. After Bush spanks Bart, an all-out prank war ensues.

episodes.title: Scenes from the Class Struggle in Springfield
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a former classmate yields an invitation to the Springfield Country Club, where Marge tries to parlay a bargain basement Chanel suit into elevated social status for her family.

episodes.title: Bart the Fink
episodes.overview: In a scheme to get Krusty's autograph, Bart sends him a check. When Krusty's offshore holding corporation endorses the check, his illegal tax shelter is exposed. In despair after the government auctions off his possessions, Krusty fakes his own death.

episodes.title: Lisa the Iconoclast
episodes.overview: While researching into Jebediah Springfield's past for an essay, Lisa discovers that the town founder wasn't the hero that everyone thinks he was.

episodes.title: Homer the Smithers
episodes.overview: Forced to take a vacation, Smithers needs to find a temporary replacement who won't outshine him. Homer seems the perfect choice until a sudden outburst forces Mr. Burns to assert his independence.

episodes.title: The Day the Violence Died
episodes.overview: Bart meets the original animator who created Itchy, penniless some 70 years after the studio stole his idea. When Bart helps him sue for restitution, he unwittingly bankrupts Itchy & Scratchy.

episodes.title: A Fish Called Selma
episodes.overview: Washed up and plagued by scandal, Troy McClure sees a marriage to Selma as his ticket back to success.

episodes.title: Bart on the Road
episodes.overview: Bart creates a fake driver's license for himself and uses it to go on a spring break road trip with Milhouse, Nelson, and Martin. Meanwhile, Homer and Lisa bond after spending some quality time together at work.

episodes.title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
episodes.overview: Bart and Milhouse wonder if anything interesting happens to the citizens of Springfield, which leads to a series of interconnected vignettes.

episodes.title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in 'The Curse of the Flying Hellfish'
episodes.overview: When a fellow veteran dies, Grandpa Simpson and Mr. Burns fight for buried WWII treasure as the only surviving members of their battalion.

episodes.title: Much Apu About Nothing
episodes.overview: When Mayor Quimby uses immigrants as a political scapegoat, the Simpsons discover that Apu is an illegal immigrant.

episodes.title: Homerpalooza
episodes.overview: To show his kids how hip he is, Homer takes Bart and Lisa to a music festival, where he earns himself a place in the sideshow by catching a cannonball with his belly.

episodes.title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
episodes.overview: On a family vacation, Lisa tries on a new identity to fit in with the other kids at the beach. Jealous, Bart reveals her true nerdiness to the group.

episodes.title: Coasts
episodes.overview: Sir David Attenborough explores the dangerous frontiers created by the world’s coasts, where animals fight for survival amidst constant change.

episodes.title: Ocean
episodes.overview: A groundbreaking journey from tropical shallow seas to the mysterious depths. Sir David Attenborough reveals extraordinary new worlds and unique animal behaviours in the ocean.

episodes.title: Deserts and Grasslands
episodes.overview: David Attenborough explores deserts and grasslands, where extraordinary life survives in unexpected ways, and nature puts on its most dramatic show.

episodes.title: Freshwater
episodes.overview: Fresh water is the lifeblood of planet Earth, where incredible animal dramas play out. From death-feigning fish to frogs that glide, each depends on fresh water for their survival.

episodes.title: Forests
episodes.overview: Sir David Attenborough journeys into the forests, where dogs communicate with whistles, treehoppers fight assassin bugs, ‘spirit bears’ fish, and hornbills imprison themselves in trees.

episodes.title: Extremes
episodes.overview: David Attenborough presents an extreme world where animals battle to survive the elements – and life exists on a knife edge.

episodes.title: Human
episodes.overview: Discover the extraordinary ways in which wildlife survives in a rapidly changing human world. From cobras hunting in houses, to rhino walking in the streets, to macaques stealing mobile phones to barter with.

episodes.title: Heroes
episodes.overview: Sir David Attenborough introduces conservation heroes fighting to save the world’s wildlife, from exploring remote jungles to going undercover to catch criminals in the illegal ivory trade.

episodes.title: Kassa
episodes.overview: Cassian Andor's reckless search for answers about his past makes him a wanted man.

episodes.title: That Would Be Me
episodes.overview: Cassian attempts to lay low on Ferrix as agents of the law close in.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.overview: Cassian's desperation to avoid arrest leads him to a mysterious man with unknown connections.

episodes.title: Aldhani
episodes.overview: Out of options, Cassian is recruited for a dangerous mission to infiltrate an Imperial garrison.

episodes.title: The Axe Forgets
episodes.overview: Cassian must carefully navigate the distrust inherent in being the new member of a secret operation.

episodes.title: The Eye
episodes.overview: With cover from a spectacular local festival, the Aldhani mission reaches a point of no return.

episodes.title: Announcement
episodes.overview: The repercussions of the Aldhani heist reach all the way to Coruscant, while Cassian returns home.

episodes.title: Narkina 5
episodes.overview: The Empire catches up to Cassian, but are as yet unaware of his identity and past.

episodes.title: Nobody's Listening!
episodes.overview: Under intense scrutiny while imprisoned, Cassian makes allies plan an impossible escape.

episodes.title: One Way Out
episodes.overview: A rare opportunity opens and the time for Cassian and his fellow inmates to act is now.

episodes.title: Daughter of Ferrix
episodes.overview: A fugitive once more, Cassian must make his next move before it is too late.

episodes.title: Rix Road
episodes.overview: Cassian returns home to Ferrix, a tinderbox that is experiencing a spark of rebellion.

episodes.title: One Year Later
episodes.overview: An undercover mission. A sanctuary threatened. A Chandrilan wedding. A chilling Imperial plan.

episodes.title: Sagrona Teema
episodes.overview: Cassian caught in a rebel turf war. Mon’s wedding woes mount. The Ferrix survivors face inspection.

episodes.title: Harvest
episodes.overview: Time is running out for everyone.

episodes.title: Ever Been to Ghorman?
episodes.overview: Cassian and Bix adjust to a Luthen safehouse. All eyes are on Ghorman. Wilmon visits Saw Gerrera.

episodes.title: I Have Friends Everywhere
episodes.overview: Cassian on Ghorman. Syril on Coruscant. Bix failing. Wilmon trapped. Kleya has a serious problem.

episodes.title: What a Festive Evening
episodes.overview: Vel and Cinta to Ghorman. Cassian home to Bix. An argument. A heist. A party. Everything at risk.

episodes.title: Messenger
episodes.overview: Yavin is growing. Wilmon comes for help. Dedra’s on Ghorman. Cassian heeds the call.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: Imperial manipulation. Ghorman frustration. Cassian and Syril center stage as Palmo erupts.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Rebellion
episodes.overview: In the Ghorman aftermath, Mon Mothma takes a stand. Cassian must carry out a difficult extraction.

episodes.title: Make It Stop
episodes.overview: Lonni Jung taps out. Dedra closes in. Luthen scrambles. Kleya delivers.

episodes.title: Who Else Knows?
episodes.overview: Cassian returns to Coruscant for one last extraction.

episodes.title: Jedha, Kyber, Erso
episodes.overview: Cassian returns to Yavin with intel that will change everything.

episodes.title: Good News About Hell
episodes.overview: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.title: Half Loop
episodes.overview: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.title: In Perpetuity
episodes.overview: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

episodes.title: The You You Are
episodes.overview: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

episodes.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.overview: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.title: Defiant Jazz
episodes.overview: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.title: What's for Dinner?
episodes.overview: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

episodes.title: The We We Are
episodes.overview: The team discovers troubling revelations.

episodes.title: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.overview: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.overview: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

episodes.title: Who Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.title: Woe's Hollow
episodes.overview: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.title: Trojan's Horse
episodes.overview: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.title: Attila
episodes.overview: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.title: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.overview: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.title: Sweet Vitriol
episodes.overview: Discoveries are made.

episodes.title: The After Hours
episodes.overview: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.title: Cold Harbor
episodes.overview: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

episodes.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

episodes.title: Wolferton Splash
episodes.overview: A young Princess Elizabeth marries Prince Philip. As King George VI’s health worsens, Winston Churchill is elected prime minister for the second time.

episodes.title: Hyde Park Corner
episodes.overview: With King George too ill to travel, Elizabeth and Philip embark on a four-continent Commonwealth tour. Party leaders attempt to undermine Churchill.

episodes.title: Windsor
episodes.overview: With Elizabeth in a new role, Philip tries to assert some power. Churchill wants to delay the coronation. King George’s disgraced brother arrives.

episodes.title: Act of God
episodes.overview: When dense smog cripples London for days and creates a serious health hazard, Churchill’s inaction leaves him vulnerable to his political enemies.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.overview: Elizabeth rejects protocol by appointing Philip to coordinate her coronation, but his ideas create conflict. The Duke of Windsor returns to London.

episodes.title: Gelignite
episodes.overview: Margaret and Peter come to Elizabeth with a request. With a royal scandal about to break in the newspapers, the Queen Mother intervenes.

episodes.title: Scientia Potentia Est
episodes.overview: As the Soviets test the H-bomb, both Churchill and Eden have major health crises. Angry about her inadequate education, Elizabeth hires a tutor.

episodes.title: Pride & Joy
episodes.overview: Elizabeth and Philip go on an exhausting world journey. Margaret takes over some of her sister’s official duties and tries to liven things up.

episodes.title: Assassins
episodes.overview: As tensions with Philip increase, Elizabeth spends time with her old friend Porchey. Churchill’s portrait is painted for his 80th birthday.

episodes.title: Gloriana
episodes.overview: Margaret and Peter are reunited, but another obstacle stands in their way. Elizabeth is torn between her duty as Queen and her love for her sister.

episodes.title: Misadventure
episodes.overview: As Philip leaves for a long tour, Elizabeth makes an upsetting discovery. Prime Minister Eden wants to strike back after Egypt seizes the Suez Canal.

episodes.title: A Company of Men
episodes.overview: Elizabeth feels disconnected from Philip. Eden copes with international pressure and ill health. An interview stirs up harrowing memories for Philip.

episodes.title: Lisbon
episodes.overview: Palace insiders try to prevent a scandal that could reflect poorly on Philip. Eden faces censure from his cabinet and the press.

episodes.title: Beryl
episodes.overview: When Elizabeth and Philip throw a grand party for their 10th anniversary, both Margaret and the new Prime Minister experience romantic tribulations.

episodes.title: Marionettes
episodes.overview: After Elizabeth makes a tone-deaf speech at a Jaguar factory, she and the monarchy come under public attack from an outspoken lord.

episodes.title: Vergangenheit
episodes.overview: A secret World War II document opens Elizabeth's eyes to grim realities about a family member. The Duke of Windsor campaigns to re-enter public life.

episodes.title: Matrimonium
episodes.overview: A letter from Peter Townsend spurs Margaret to make a bold proposal. Elizabeth has good news that causes complications for Margaret.

episodes.title: Dear Mrs. Kennedy
episodes.overview: Inspired by Jackie Kennedy and against her government's wishes, Elizabeth takes an unconventional approach to resolving an issue with Ghana.

episodes.title: Paterfamilias
episodes.overview: Philip insists that Prince Charles attend his alma mater in Scotland and reminisces about the life-changing difficulties he experienced there.

episodes.title: Mystery Man
episodes.overview: A salacious government scandal hits close to home for Elizabeth and Philip. Elizabeth retreats to Scotland for rest during a difficult pregnancy.

episodes.title: Olding
episodes.overview: The royal family mourns the passing of Winston Churchill. The United Kingdom ushers in a new prime minister, the Labour Party's Harold Wilson whom Prince Philip and Queen Elizabeth hear might be a Soviet spy.

episodes.title: Margaretology
episodes.overview: While Princess Margaret and Lord Snowdon visit the USA, the queen, at the bidding of Harold Wilson, asks them to make a side trip to Washington, D.C. to ask President Johnson for financial assistance for the United Kingdom.

episodes.title: Aberfan
episodes.overview: A horrible disaster in the Welsh town of Aberfan leaves scores of children dead, but when the Queen takes a week to decide to visit the town to offer solace to its people, she must confront her reasons for postponing the trip.

episodes.title: Bubbikins
episodes.overview: Left without a home by a political coup in Athens, Philip's eccentric mother, Princess Alice of Greece, is invited to live in Buckingham Palace by the Queen.

episodes.title: Coup
episodes.overview: While the Queen travels abroad to learn about horse training, unhappiness among the British elite with the devaluation of the pound involves Lord Mountbatten in a plan to oust Harold Wilson.

episodes.title: Tywysog Cymru
episodes.overview: Prince Charles is sent to Aberystwyth to learn Welsh from an ardent nationalist in preparation for the ceremony for his investiture as Prince of Wales.

episodes.title: Moondust
episodes.overview: The 1969 moon landing occasions a mid-life crisis in Prince Philip, who thinks of the adventures he has missed as the Queen's consort.

episodes.title: Dangling Man
episodes.overview: Charles visits the exiled Duke of Windsor in his Paris chateau, only to find him very ill. But will the Queen make peace with her uncle before he dies?

episodes.title: Imbroglio
episodes.overview: While Princess Anne dates her elder brother's polo rival Andrew Parker Bowles, Prince Charles falls deeply in love with Camilla Shand causing the Queen Mother and Lord Mountbatten to interfere.

episodes.title: Cri de Coeur
episodes.overview: As her marriage falls apart, Princess Margaret finds solace in the arms of a much younger landscape gardener. The Queen and the nation celebrate Elizabeth II's Silver Jubilee.

episodes.title: Rose
episodes.overview: Rose Tyler meets a mysterious stranger called the Doctor, and realises Earth is in danger.

episodes.title: The End of the World
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Rose on her first voyage through time: to the year five billion, when the Sun is about to expand and swallow the Earth. She is cautious and soon starts to question her reasons for joining The Doctor. But amongst the powerful alien races gathering to watch on Platform One, a murderer is at work. Who is controlling the mysterious and deadly metal spiders?

episodes.title: The Unquiet Dead
episodes.overview: Charles Dickens and the Doctor team up as corpses stalk the streets of Victorian Cardiff.

episodes.title: Aliens of London (1)
episodes.overview: Rose is taken home, but a spaceship crashes in the Thames and London is closed off... Enter the Slitheen!

episodes.title: World War Three (2)
episodes.overview: Time is running out for the Doctor as Downing Street announces mankind's first Interplanetary War.

episodes.title: Dalek
episodes.overview: The Doctor is shattered and Earth is in danger as he and Rose discover the Time Lords' deadliest enemy beneath Utah.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.overview: Adam catches a glimpse of the wonders of travelling in the Tardis, as they head to a future, where Satellite 5 broadcasts to the entire Earth Empire. But anyone promoted to Floor 500 is never seen again, and the Doctor suspects mankind is being manipulated.

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.overview: Rose requests a trip back to the day her father, Pete Tyler, died. Reluctantly, the Doctor agrees, but he realises he has made a mistake, when Rose saves Pete from being run over by a car. This has now changed the timeline, and Reapers are transposing themselves all over the Universe. However, this time, the Doctor doesn't have a plan…

episodes.title: The Empty Child (1)
episodes.overview: After chasing an unexplained capsule through time, the TARDIS lands in London, during an air raid. Rose investigates when a small child wearing a gasmask, standing on a rooftop, continuously calls out for his mummy. After floating above the city on a barrage balloon, Rose is swept off her feet by another time traveller – Captain Jack Harkness. Meanwhile, The Doctor follows a teenaged girl to a meeting of the homeless children of the Blitz. Here, the child in the gasmask is terrorising them with a parade of strange events, constantly asking for his mother.

episodes.title: The Doctor Dances (2)
episodes.overview: After narrowly escaping the gas mask monsters, The Doctor, Rose, and Captain Jack try to stop the mutated people from infecting other victims. But it soon becomes apparent that one of the group may indirectly responsible for the virus. The answer lies at the bomb site, but time is running out...

episodes.title: Boom Town
episodes.overview: The Doctor, Rose and Captain Jack stop off in present-day Cardiff to recharge the TARDIS on the Rift they formerly encountered in 1869. Whilst there, they come upon a since-thought-long-dead enemy of theirs, who is hatching yet another plan to destroy Earth.

episodes.title: Bad Wolf (1)
episodes.overview: In a seemingly futuristic world, the Doctor wakes up in the Big Brother house during an eviction, Rose wakes up on the Weakest Link with the Anne-Droid, and Captain Jack gets a make over with Trin-E and Zu-Zana. But something unusual is happening, and the losing contestants are being disintegrated. Obviously, it's time for the Doctor to investigate. Who or what is behind this?

episodes.title: New Earth
episodes.overview: In the year five billion and twenty-three, after the destruction of the Earth, the Doctor takes Rose to the New Earth. There, in a hospital facility, the feline Sisters of Plenitude can mysteriously cure any diseases, but, in the basement, an old enemy of the Doctor is out for revenge.

episodes.title: Tooth and Claw
episodes.overview: Landing in 1879, Scotland, the Tenth Doctor and Rose meet Queen Victoria, travelling with her to spend the night at the Torchwood Estate. However, a group of warrior monks have sinister plans for the monarch, and the full moon is about to summon a creature out of legend.

episodes.title: School Reunion
episodes.overview: There are strange goings-on at a comprehensive school - UFOs, over-intelligent children, and odd-tasting school dinners. This attracts the attention of the Tenth Doctor, Rose and Mickey Smith, as well as a couple of old friends…

episodes.title: The Girl in the Fireplace
episodes.overview: On a seemingly abandoned spaceship in the 51st century, the Tenth Doctor, Rose and Mickey find time windows leading to 18th century France and a group of clockwork androids using them to stalk a young woman throughout her life.

episodes.title: Rise of the Cybermen (1)
episodes.overview: After the TARDIS makes a crash landing on the Earth of another universe, Rose discovers her father is alive and rich, Mickey encounters his alternative self, and the Tenth Doctor learns one of his oldest and deadliest foes is about to be reborn.

episodes.title: The Age of Steel (2)
episodes.overview: The plans of John Lumic to convert the world into Cybermen are now in full force. The Tenth Doctor, Rose, Mickey and the Preachers must find a way to stop him from enforcing his "ultimate upgrade."

episodes.title: The Idiot's Lantern
episodes.overview: In 1953 London, the police are abducting people from their homes. The people of Britain gather around their new-fangled "tele-vision" sets to celebrate the new Queen's coronation - but something strange is affecting the signal.

episodes.title: The Impossible Planet (1)
episodes.overview: Rose finds herself further away from home than ever before, on a desolate world in the orbit of a Black Hole. Trapped with an Earth expedition and the mysterious Ood, the time-travellers face an even greater danger as something ancient beneath the planet's surface begins to awake.

episodes.title: The Satan Pit (2)
episodes.overview: The TARDIS lands in a base on a planet orbiting a black hole, an impossible situation that stumps even the Tenth Doctor. The base crew are drilling to the centre of the world, to claim the power that keeps it in orbit for themselves. However, an ancient evil is down there too, and he is awake…

episodes.title: Love & Monsters
episodes.overview: An ordinary man named Elton Pope becomes obsessed with the Tenth Doctor, Rose and their strange blue box, joining a group of like-minded people in hopes of finding him. But when the mysterious Victor Kennedy joins the group, the fun soon stops and Elton discovers a darker side to his hobby.

episodes.title: Fear Her
episodes.overview: When the TARDIS lands in 2012, the Tenth Doctor plans to show Rose the London Olympics. However, ordinary children are vanishing into thin air, a mother living in a seemingly normal British household is trying to hide her daughter's unnatural powers from the world, and a demonic presence lurks in an upstairs cupboard.

episodes.title: Army of Ghosts (1)
episodes.overview: Ghostly beings have been regularly appearing across the world and people, believing them to be their dead loved ones, are welcoming their visits with open arms. When the TARDIS arrives at the Torchwood Institute, the Tenth Doctor and Rose are taken prisoner. They are drawn into the investigation of a mysterious sphere kept in Torchwood Tower, and monstrous foes return as two universes collide.

episodes.title: Smith and Jones
episodes.overview: Trainee doctor Martha Jones has her hands full balancing her medical studies with placating her demanding family. So the last thing she needs is to find that the hospital where she works has been transported to the moon, where it's invaded by an overbearing alien police force. There she encounters a patient called John Smith, who seems curiously at ease with the situation…

episodes.title: The Shakespeare Code
episodes.overview: Martha takes her first trip in the Tardis, all the way back to Elizabethan England. She and the Doctor hear of a series of bizarre deaths and discover that playwright William Shakespeare is being controlled by dangerous witch-like creatures. It seems the time-travelling duo must defeat ancient forces to prevent history from being rewritten.

episodes.title: Gridlock
episodes.overview: The Doctor takes Martha to New Earth, in the far future, only to find that an entire city has become a deadly trap.

episodes.title: Daleks in Manhattan (1)
episodes.overview: The Doctor investigates disappearances in New York at the height of the depression in the 1930s. Nefarious Pig Men linger in the sewers and the Daleks prepare an audacious plan at the top of the Empire State Building

episodes.title: Evolution of the Daleks (2)
episodes.overview: The newly-created Dalek-human hybrid, and the other three members of the Cult of Skaro launch an attack on Hooverville, along with their Pig Slaves. The Doctor, Martha, and Frank manage to escape, but discover that the Daleks' plan involving the Empire State Building...

episodes.title: The Lazarus Experiment
episodes.overview: Martha has to save her family from the lunatic schemes of the monstrous Professor Lazarus.

In a far-flung galaxy, saboteurs are at work, and crew members are being possessed. The TARDIS crew find themselves in the 42nd century on a spaceship, SS Pentallian, slowly being pulled into a sun, and must find a way to survive

episodes.title: Human Nature (1)
episodes.overview: England, 1913. A schoolteacher called John Smith dreams of adventures in time and space. The Doctor, along with Martha, heads to a boarding school, but what he finds is far from ordinary...

episodes.title: The Family of Blood (2)
episodes.overview: It's 1913, and war comes to England early as the terrifying Family hunt for the Doctor.

episodes.title: Blink
episodes.overview: Only the Doctor can stop the Weeping Angels, but he's lost in time.

episodes.title: Utopia (1)
episodes.overview: After being brought back to life in The Parting of the Ways, Captain Jack Harkness was just left on the Gamestation by the Doctor and Rose. In this episode, Captain Jack Harkness storms back into the Doctor's life, and the TARDIS is thrown to the end of the universe itself.

episodes.title: The Sound of Drums (2)
episodes.overview: Harry Saxon becomes Prime Minister and his reign of terror begins – but that's only the start of his ambitions, as he announces mankind's first contact with an alien race, the Toclafane. An audacious plan spanning the whole of time and space begins to close around the Earth, in the penultimate episode of Russell T Davies's Doctor Who.

episodes.title: Failure's Contagious
episodes.overview: River Cartwright is ousted from MI5 and finds himself in a place worse than purgatory: Slough House, dumping ground for failed spies.

episodes.title: Work Drinks
episodes.overview: River and Sid join forces. A misfired gun has dire consequences.

episodes.title: Bad Tradecraft
episodes.overview: Slough House is the unlikely venue for a secret romance, but events take a dark turn when a dangerous encounter becomes deadly.

episodes.title: Visiting Hours
episodes.overview: Taverner sends the Dogs to hunt down Lamb and the Slow Horses. River holds the secret to saving the gang.

episodes.title: Fiasco
episodes.overview: The Slow Horses must disappear to avoid capture by MI5. Lamb and River head to The Park to outwit Taverner.

episodes.title: Follies
episodes.overview: Taverner and the Slow Horses attempt different approaches to locate the kidnappers and Hassan. Ho makes a shocking discovery about Sid.

episodes.title: Last Stop
episodes.overview: Jackson Lamb is on high alert after a former spy is found dead. Min and Louisa are tempted by an offer from outside Slough House.

episodes.title: From Upshott with Love
episodes.overview: Lamb liaises with a Russian defector who may hold a clue to sleeper agents. River is on the trail of a ruthless assassin.

episodes.title: Drinking Games
episodes.overview: River gets cozy in the Cotswolds while searching for a sleeper agent. Min discovers Russian drinking games are the most brutal of all.

episodes.title: Cicada
episodes.overview: Louisa makes her move on Pashkin. Catherine makes moves of a different kind when she plays high-stakes chess with a sinister stranger.

episodes.title: Boardroom Politics
episodes.overview: Lamb orders his Slow Horses to walk into traps. River believes something alarming is heading toward London.

episodes.title: Old Scores
episodes.overview: Lamb and Katinsky go head-to-head. Ho finds himself trapped on a train with a Russian assassin.

episodes.title: Strange Games
episodes.overview: A romantic relationship in Istanbul ends badly. Lamb hits the panic button when one of his Slow Horses fails to show up for work.

episodes.title: Hard Lessons
episodes.overview: River has to steal something out of the Park to save a life. Lamb realizes a stranger game is afoot.

episodes.title: Negotiating with Tigers
episodes.overview: Marcus and Shirley face Lamb's wrath. River discovers revenge is a dish best served cold.

episodes.title: Uninvited Guests
episodes.overview: Tearney makes a bold move. The Slow Horses assist the Tiger Team, unaware of their hidden agenda. Lamb and Ho take a road trip.

episodes.title: Cleaning Up
episodes.overview: Taverner and Tearney face off for control of MI5. River and Louisa find themselves caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Footprints
episodes.overview: The Slow Horses fight for their lives. Lamb shares some devastating truths with Catherine.

episodes.title: When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.overview: 2003. As a parasitic fungal outbreak begins to ravage the country and the world, Joel Miller attempts to escape the escalating chaos with his daughter and brother. Twenty years later, a now hardened Joel and his partner Tess fight to survive under a totalitarian regime, while the insurgent Fireflies harbor a teenage girl with a unique gift.

episodes.title: Infected
episodes.overview: In 2003, an Indonesian scientist makes a devastating discovery. In 2023, now outside of the quarantine zone, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate as they navigate a long-abandoned Boston overrun with Infected.

episodes.title: Long, Long Time
episodes.overview: Doomsday prepper Bill prepares to ride out the apocalypse alone...until a mysterious stranger upends his plans. Years later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance – and find themselves at a crossroads.

episodes.title: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.overview: After a harrowing trek across a desolate United States, Joel and Ellie find themselves navigating a dangerous Kansas City on foot. Later, rebel leader Kathleen instigates a manhunt – one that pits her violent civilian militia against the world's best hope.

episodes.title: Endure and Survive
episodes.overview: On the streets of a newly free Kansas City, Henry fights to protect his brother Sam from rebel soldiers who will stop at nothing to appease their ruthless leader. As her manhunt continues, Kathleen doubles down on her quest for revenge, while Ellie forms a meaningful friendship.

episodes.title: Kin
episodes.overview: After months of traveling, Joel and Ellie receive a grave warning about what lies ahead. Later, Ellie learns more about Joel's past – while Joel tries his best to forget.

episodes.title: Left Behind
episodes.overview: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie’s struggle to save him stirs memories of her life in a FEDRA orphanage. Weeks before meeting Joel, Ellie recalls joining her best friend Riley for a night to remember… one that will change the course of both of their lives – and the fate of the world – forever.

episodes.title: When We Are in Need
episodes.overview: After crossing paths with a vengeful group of survivors, Ellie's fighting spirit draws unwanted attention from its leader. Still battling for his life, a weakened Joel faces off with a hunting party out for blood.

episodes.title: Look for the Light
episodes.overview: After being pursued by Infected, a pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Years later, Ellie is forced to grapple with the emotional toll of her journey, while Joel faces a devastating decision of his own.

episodes.title: Future Days
episodes.overview: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

episodes.title: Through the Valley
episodes.overview: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

episodes.title: The Path
episodes.overview: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

episodes.title: Day One
episodes.overview: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

episodes.title: Feel Her Love
episodes.overview: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

episodes.title: The Price
episodes.overview: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. Years later, Ellie prepares to confront Joel about her past.

episodes.title: Convergence
episodes.overview: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

episodes.title: System
episodes.overview: Carmy attempts to retrain the employees of The Original Beef of Chicagoland, but is faced with resistance; in need of back-up, he brings on a talented young chef to help.

episodes.title: Hands
episodes.overview: A surprise health inspection reveals the cracks in the restaurant's foundation. Carmy goes head-to-head with Richie.

episodes.title: Brigade
episodes.overview: Carmy attends Al-Anon. Sydney struggles to gain the respect of the staff.

episodes.title: Dogs
episodes.overview: Carmy and Richie cater a kid's birthday party. Tina and Sydney work together while Marcus makes donuts.

episodes.title: Sheridan
episodes.overview: Things go wrong in the kitchen. Sydney finds solutions.

episodes.title: Ceres
episodes.overview: Richie notices the neighborhood is changing. Sugar and Carmy clean up the office.

episodes.title: Review
episodes.overview: A bad day in the kitchen causes tensions to rise.

episodes.title: Braciole
episodes.overview: Things get out of control. Carmy is faced with a decision.

episodes.title: Beef
episodes.overview: Faced with the reality of opening a new restaurant, the crew must make a plan.

episodes.title: Pasta
episodes.overview: The crew splits up to work towards their new vision.

episodes.title: Sundae
episodes.overview: Sydney searches Chicago for culinary inspiration.

episodes.title: Honeydew
episodes.overview: Marcus challenges himself.

episodes.title: Pop
episodes.overview: The renovation gets off track.

episodes.title: Fishes
episodes.overview: Feast of the Seven Fishes.

episodes.title: Forks
episodes.overview: Richie stages.

episodes.title: Bolognese
episodes.overview: The crew awaits a do-or-die fire suppression test.

episodes.title: Omelette
episodes.overview: Final preparations are made for The Bear's first service.

episodes.title: The Bear
episodes.overview: Friends & Family night at The Bear.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.overview: The next day and the days that led to it.

episodes.title: Next
episodes.overview: Carmy sets a new standard.

episodes.title: Doors
episodes.overview: The staff slogs through a month of service.

episodes.title: Violet
episodes.overview: Sydney gets a new apartment. Marcus finds inspiration.

episodes.title: Children
episodes.overview: The Computer gives The Bear its odds.

episodes.title: Napkins
episodes.overview: Tina looks for a new opportunity.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.overview: The restaurant is out of C-Folds. Sydney is presented with an opportunity.

episodes.title: Ice Chips
episodes.overview: Sugar finds support in an unexpected place.

episodes.title: Apologies
episodes.overview: Carmy thinks about apologizing.

episodes.title: Forever
episodes.overview: Another funeral.

episodes.title: Anjin
episodes.overview: Destinies converge in Japan after a barbarian ship washes ashore in a poor fishing village. Meanwhile, in Osaka, Lord Toranaga finds himself outplayed by his enemies.

episodes.title: Servants of Two Masters
episodes.overview: Blackthorne's arrival in Osaka stirs up a hornet's nest of rivalries. Mariko is trapped between her cause and her faith when she must translate for the barbarian in Lord Toranaga's custody.

episodes.title: Tomorrow Is Tomorrow
episodes.overview: After Blackthorne survives a brazen assassination attempt, Toranaga realizes he must ferry his allies out of Osaka or risk certain defeat.

episodes.title: The Eightfold Fence
episodes.overview: Blackthorne and Mariko test their new alliance as they train Toranaga's gun regiment for war. Yabushige must navigate his past promises to Ishido when an old friend comes to the village.

episodes.title: Broken to the Fist
episodes.overview: Blackthorne and Mariko struggle to contain the secret that could get them both killed. Yabushige searches for the spy who has betrayed his intentions to Lord Toranaga.

episodes.title: Ladies of the Willow World
episodes.overview: Lady Ochiba returns to Osaka in order to accelerate the Regents' campaign against Toranaga. In Ajiro, Toranaga tests Mariko's loyalty to his cause.

episodes.title: A Stick of Time
episodes.overview: Outplayed by new alliances in Osaka, Toranaga is forced to carve out a new deal with a long lost family member.

episodes.title: The Abyss of Life
episodes.overview: Toranaga's defeated clan moves to Edo and awaits their fate. Blackthorne must decide who he fights for - the lord who has turned his back on him, or the ambition that brought him to Japan in the first place.

episodes.title: Crimson Sky
episodes.overview: Mariko arrives in Osaka for the fight of her life. Blackthorne and Yabushige scramble to save their own heads as their options dwindle.

episodes.title: A Dream of a Dream
episodes.overview: In the wake of a tragic death, Blackthorne finally considers the true nature of Toranaga's plan.

episodes.overview: The celebs hit the sofa for a new series. What do Rylan and his mum, Tom Allen, Mo Gilligan, Vicky Pattison, Denise van Outen and many other famous folk think of Rivals, Scream 7, BGT and Canal Boat Diaries?

episodes.overview: This time the celebs watched I Kissed a Girl, First Dates, Office Romance, The 1% Club, Billy and Molly: An Otter Love Story, Police Interceptors and BBC News (Starmer resigns).
